data.long_meaning: The name Aayla is derived from the Arabic word 'a'yla' which means mountain gazelle. In Islamic tradition, the name is believed to symbolize grace, agility, and strength. The name Aayla carries the meaning “Mountain Gazelle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aayla usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain gazelle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
